trait.name: Altitude Acclimation
trait.description: You are naturally acclimated to high altitudes, including elevations above 20,000 feet, even if you have never visited them. You do not incur high-altitude travel penalties that arise solely from a lack of acclimation, and spending time at lower elevations does not remove this adaptation. You must still breathe normally and are not protected from extreme cold, unrelated environmental hazards, or loss of air.
